tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sa skya bka' 'bum zhu bsdur skor nyung ngu*/ /

༄༅/ /da lta dngos su sa skya bka' 'bum pod bco brgyad la dpe bsdur dang*/ gsar rnyed pod kyi bsdur bsgrigs ji ltar byas tshul yang spyi lo 2004lo nas 'go btsugs nas dus yun lo gnyis tsam ring las ka byas/ gtso bo lu phur yod pa'i sa skya bka' 'bum pod chen bcu dang*/ zha lu dgon du bzhugs pa'i pod chen bcu bdun rnams sde dge'i shing spar pod bco lnga dang phan tshun bsdur nas tshig mi 'dra ba'i cha rnams so sor gug rtags brgyab nas bzo bcos ma byas par bkod nas gzigs pa po rnams kyi dus gcig la dpe khag gsum mjal thub pa'i mthun rkyen bsgrigs yod/ gug rtags kyis mtshon tshul ni()'di ni sde dge dang zha lu ma mthun skabs sde dge'i mi 'dra ba'i rtags yin la/¡²¡³'di ni lu phu dang sde dge mi 'dra ba byung dus sde dge'i mi 'dra ba'i rtags yin/ <>'di ni zha lu dang lu phu gnyis 'dra la/ sde dge'i mi 'dra ba'i rtags yin/[zha/][la/] 'di'i yi ge zha dang la de zha lu dang lu phu so so'i mtshon rtags ming yig dang po dang bed spyad nas bkod/ zha lu dang lu phu gcig mthun la gug rtags [zha/la/]'di'i nang gong gi ming gnyis mnyam du bcug yod/ ( )'di ni don la the tshom yod pa'i skabs ma dpe'i tshig ji bzhin bzhag nas rang dwogs rtags 'di'i nang bkod yod/ yang tshig mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig ni brjod tshul rgyas bsdus tsam las don la khyad par med la/ 'ga' zhig ni don la'ang khyad par chen po 'dug ste/ dpe 'ga' zhig bkod na 'di ltar/ sa paṇa gyi gsung pod dang po thub pa'i dgongs gsal nang*/ bden pa gnyis kyi rnam gzhag brjod pa'i skabs sde dger (las mthun pa la snang ba tha dad du don byed nus shing )zhes par zha lur [zha/ las mthun pa la snang ba tha snyad du don byed ]ces dang*/ de bzhin (so so skye bo'i blo ma dpyad pa'i ngor snang ba rnam grangs yin pa'i kun rdzob )ces par [zha/

so so'i skye bo'i blo ma dpyad pa'i don snang ba rnam grangs ma yin pa'i kun rdzob ]dang*/ yang thub pa'i dgongs gsal shes rab bshad pa'i skabs su rgya nag mkhan po dang slob dpon pad ma'i ngang tshul gyi rtsod yig skabs (rnam par rtog pa mtha' dag bkag pa yin no zhe na/ )[zha/ rnam par mi rtog pa mtha' dag bkag pa yin no zhe na/ ]zhes dang*/ gzhung lugs legs bshad las rgyang 'phen 'gog pa'i skabs (sems ni nam mkha'i bag la zhi/)[zha/ sems ni nam mkha'i bag la nyal/]zhes tshig mi 'dra tsam dang*/ yang sgra nyer bsdu'i skabs (yang dag pa'i don rtogs pa ga la 'gyur )zhes par [zha/ yang dag pa'i don rtogs par 'gyur ]zhes dang*/ me tog chun por (l̥ la ring po med mod kyi/ /ṛ la gsum ga tshang bar yod/ /)ces par/ [zha/ ṛ la ring po med mod kyi/ /l̥ la gsum ga tshang bar yod/ ]ces pa yod/ bdag med bstod 'grel skabs su (mos pas thob pa ni mos pas spyod pa'i sa )zhes par/ [zha/ mos pas thob pa ni mos pas thob pa'i sa ]zhes yod/ yang rje btsun rnam thar skabs (bdag cag la nges med kyi )zhes par [zha/ bdag cag la nges shes yod mod kyi ]zhes pa sogs yod/ yang 'ga' zhig tshig rgyas bsdus brjod srol re gnyis tsam dang phrad bsdu ba byas ma byas tsam re gnyis yar blugs med la de min kun rang sor bcug yod/ de bzhin sde dge'i dpar mar yang deng gi sum rtags 'gros dang mi mthun pa'i phrad rkyen nor ba 'ga' re yod pa rnams sum rtags dgongs pa ji bzhin bkod la/ gzhag ces pa la bya tshig dang ming tshig khyad par med par kun ga gzhag mang po yod pa rnams mkhas pa 'gas nga tshos nor bar ngos 'dzin srid pas bya tshig ming tshig dbye ba phye nas ga gzhag dang ba bzhag tha dad bzos pa yin/ de bzhin yig shad de yang thams cad mkhyen pa rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i dgongs pa bzhin ga ka sha rnams rgyab dang*/ tshig 'gor kha byung na ma brgyab par de'i rkang pa des 'thus par byas yod/

yang tshan pa khag gi 'gor btsal bde phyir sbrul shad*༈gsar du bsnan yod do/ /'on kyang nged rnams thos rgya dang bsam rgya de bzhin dus yun thung la nyams myong sogs shin tu dman pas lhag bsam bzang pos ji ltar bsgrub kyang skyon gyi gong bu lta bur 'ong srid pas 'di'i skor la zhe sdang dang phrag dog sogs kyis thugs ma brgyan par lhag bsam gangs ri las byung ba'i zhal gdam sman chab gang bzang bstsal rgyu'i re ba snying nas bcangs shing yod pas dgongs pa'ajags yod pa mkhyen/ gnyis pa bzhugs byang re'u mig ni/ chos tshan rnams la dpe bsdur yod na zha lu dang lu phu so so'i 'og tu yod ces pa dang dpe bsdur med na med ces bkod yod la/ dpe bsdur skabs ma dpe'i nang gnas tshul ci yod zur du dmigs bsal gnas tshul zhes pa'i re'u mig nang so so'i ming bcas bkod yod/ de'i 'og kha skong pod gsum dang*/ yang skong pod rnams las gong ma re res mdzad pa'i chos tshan gyi grangs bcas bkod yod/ 'dir nan brjod bya dgos pa zhig la rje sa chen gsung gi nang bla ma mnga' ris pas mdzad pa'i brtag gnyis 'grel pa dang*/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung gi nang mkha' spyod chos skor rgya gzhung mi dbang chos gsum dang*/ rje btsun grags pa'i don zhags skabs su dha byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang*/ 'jam mgon sa paṇa gsung gi nang rje btsun grags pa'i slob ma slob dpon su badz+ras mdzad pa'i bde mchog 'bru 'bum dang*/ zhang mdo sde pas mdzad pa'i chos rje'i rnam thar bcas/ 'phags pa'i gsung gi nang 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs 'di kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta ta thā ga ta bha dras mdzad pa 'phags pas bsgyur ba dang*/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa'i rnam par bshad pa gsung rab gsal ba'i rgyan slob ma shes rab gzhon nus mdzad pa yod pa rnams sngar sde dge'i shing dpar nang mkhas pa gong ma rnams kyis bcug pa rnams sngar rgyun bzhin rang sor bzhag yod/

slar 'dir da dung gal che ba zhu rgyur da res rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung 'bum rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa ma zad gcig gyur gyi deb spud legs zhig ngal ba ci lta bu byung yang dang du blangs nas bzo bzhin yod pas phyogs khag gi gang zag dang skyes chen su 'dra zhig la gong ma lnga'i gsung dkon pa dang*/ de bzhin gzhan las mthong thos sogs ci byung ba rnams 'dir mkho 'don gnang rgyu'i re ba skom pa chu 'dod ltar bcangs zhing yod pas bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'di nyid la dgongs nas bsod nams phran bu bsag rgyu'i smon lam zhu'o/ /dkar chag rgyas pa zhig zur du bris yod pas rezhig de tsam mo/ /dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po'i gsung*/ (kasde dge'i dpar ma/zha lu/lu phu/dmigs bsal gnas tshul/1 dpal ldan be ru pa la bstod pa bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/2 zhang ston la bstod pa bzhugs so/ /med/yod/3 rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/4 brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad bzhugs so/ /yod/med/5 bla ma mnga' ris pas mdzad pa'i brtag gnyis kyi tshig 'grel/med/med/gsungs dngos min/6 dpal ldan kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i dka' 'grel bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/7 rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi dka' 'grel bzhugs so/ /med/yod/8 rdo rje gur gyi tho yig bzhugs so/ /yod/med/9 gur rigs bsdus kyi rig pa'i dbang lnga'i bshad pa bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/10 gur gyi dka' 'grel bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/11 mchog sgrub pa'i ngang las rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi grangs bzhugs so/ /med/med/12 rdo rje glu'i bshad pa bzhugs so/ /yod/med/13 rtsa'i mngon rtogs bzhugs so/ /yod/med/14 rdo rje snying 'grel snga 'gyur gyi yig sna bzhugs so/yod/med/15 gur gyi rgyud kyi zin bris bzhugs so/ yod/yod/16 saṃ bho ta'i dka' 'grel bzhugs so/ /yod/med/17

kha sbyor thig le'i don 'byung ba bzhugs so/ /med/med/18 dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i rnal 'byor bshad pa bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/19 kha sbyor phyi ma'i brtag pa bcu'i don bshad pa bzhugs so/ /med/yod/20 bsdus pa'i dal du slob ma la dbang bskur ba bzhugs so/ /med/yod/21 'jigs byed rtog pa bdun pa'i ṭīk+ka bzhugs soyod/yod/22 sgrol ma lha bcu bdun pa'i dkyil chog ṭīk+ka bzhugs so/yod/yod/23 man ngag gces par btus pa rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so/ /yod/med/24 dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub skaur bzhugs so// med/med/25 dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi ṭīka mu tig phreng ba bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/26 slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi bsdus don bzhugs so//med/med/27 mngon rtogs tshig gi bum pa bzhugs so/ /med/med/28 sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi bsdus don bzhugs so//med/med/29 gdan gyi rnam dag bzhugs so/ /med/med/30 mngon byung gi rnam 'phrul bzhugs so/ /med/med/31 ḍoṃ bi pa'i de nyid bcu'i dka' 'grel bzhugs so/med/med/32 kag chol gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 'grel po/ /med/med/33 bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi bsdus don bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/34 bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le 'grel bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/35 bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi dka' 'grel bzhugs so/yod/med/36 nag po dkyil chog gi tho yig bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/ sde dge'i dpar ma/ (khazha lu/lu phu/dmigs bsal gnas tshul/37 bde mchog nag po pa'i lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/yod/med/38 gzhung drug spyi'i rnam gzhagamed/med/39 dkyil chog sa bcad bzhugs so/ /med/med/40 sgrub thabs sa bcad bzhugs so/ /med/med/41 sbyin sreg sa bcad bzhugs so/ /med/med/42 gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba'i sa bcad bzhugs so/

/yod/med/43 o la pa te'i sa bcad bzhugs so/ /yod/med/44 dpyid kyi thig le'i sa bcad bzhugs so/ /med/med/45 ras ris la brten pa'i dkyil chog bzhugs so/yod/yod/46 mngon rtogs kyi ṭīka bzhugs so/ /yod/med/47 sbyin sreg gi ṭīka bzhugs so/ /yod/med/48 sbyin sreg gi lag len bzhugs so/ /yod/med/49 ro sreg bzhugs so/ /yod/med/50 gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi ṭīka bzhugs so/ /yod/med/51 de'i tshig don bsdus pa'i go 'byed bzhugs so/ /yod/med/52 gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi cha bla ma'i gsung gnang ba bris pa bzhugs/yod/med/53 o la pa te'i rnam bshad bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/55 de'i man ngag bzhugs so/ /yod/med/56 dpyid thig gi ṭīk+ka bzhugs so/ /yod/med/57 rim pa bzhi pa'i gdams ngag bzhugs so/ /yod/med/slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo'i gsung*/ sde dge'i dpar ma/ (gzha lu/lu phu/dmigs bsal gnas tshul/1 rgyud sde spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/2 rje sa chen la bstod pa bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/3 brgyud pa dang bcas pa la gsol ba 'debs pa bzhugs so/ /yod/med/4 rgya sgom tshul khrims grags la springs pa bzhugs so/ yod/yod/5 slob dpon phywa pa la bstod pa bzhugs so/ /yod/yod/6 bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs/ yod/yod/7 dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bshad pa nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhugs/ yod/yod/8 bzang po yongs bzung gi rab gnas kyi ṭīka bzhugs so/ /med/med/9 sbyin sreg gi ṭīka bzhugs so/ /yod/med/10 dpal kye rdo rje'i sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi ṭīka bzhugs so/ /med/med/11 dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil chog nas gling ma bzhugs so/ /med/med/12 dang po'i las can gyi bya ba'i rim pa dang lam rim bgrod tshul bzhugs so/ /med/med/13 ḍoṃ bi he ru ka'i lugs kyi kye rdo rje'i dkyil chog bzhugs so/

/med/med/14 dpal kye rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i bsdus don bzhugs/ yod/med/15 saṃ pu ṭa'i ṭīka rgyud kyi bsdus don bzhugs so/ /med/med/ sde dge'i dpar ma/ (ngazha lu/lu phu/dmigs bsal gnas tshul/16 sam+bhu ṭa'i ṭīka gnad kyi gsal byed bzhugs so/ /med/yod/17 ṭīka gnad kyi gsal byed bzhugs so/ /med/yod/18 saṃ bhu ṭa'i brtag pa gnyis pa'i rab byed gnyis pa'i ṭīka bzhugs so/ /med/yod/19 chos la 'jug pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so/ /med/yod/20 yi ge'i bklag thabs byis pa bde bklag tu 'jug pa bzhugs/ med/med sde dge'i dpar ma/ (cazha lu/lu phu/dmigs bsal gnas tshul/21 dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yan lag bzhi pa bzhugs/ med/med/22 dpal kye rdo rje'i dal du slob ma smin byaid cho ga dbang chu chen mo bzhugs/ med/med/23 dpal kye rdo rje'i rab tu gnas pa bzang po drug ces bya ba bzhugs/ med/med/24 zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bzhugs so/ /med/med/25 las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bzhugs/ med/med/26 bdag med ma'i dbang gi tho yig med/med/27 bde mchog dril bu pa'i gzhung gi mngon par rtogs pa bzhugs/ yod/med/28 de yi dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus bzhugs/ med/med/29 dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mchod phreng bzhugs/med/med/30 gtsug tor rnam rgyal rtog pa'i ṭīka bzhugs/ yod/med/31 de yi sa bcad bzhugs/ med/med/32 'jig rten dbang phyug seṅge sgra'i sgrub thabs dang gdon dgrol gyi cho ga /med/med/33 seng ge sgra'i sa bcad bzhugs/ yod/med/34 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i lo rgyus bzhugs/ med/med/35 don yod zhags pa'i sa bcad bzhugs/ med/med/36 lha lnga'i bstod pa bzhugs so/ /med/med/37 don zhags rgyud chung gi ṭīka bzhugs/ med/med/38 gtor chen gyi lo rgyus dang ṭīka bzhugs/ med/med/39 rdo rje gdan pa'i chos drug bzhugs/

yod/med/40 mi g.yo ba'i chos skor rgya gzhung bstod pa dang bcas pa bzhugs/ yod/med/41 mi g.yo ba'i 'khor lo bzhugs so/ /yod/med/42 byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa bzhugs so/ /yod/med/rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sde dge'i dpar ma/ (chazha lu/lu phu/dmigs bsal gnas tshul/1 mngon par rtogs pa rin po che'i ljon shing*/ yod/yod/2 stong thun sa bcad/ yod/yod/mi 'dra ba shin tu mang*/ 3 lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ med/yod/4bla ma'i rnam thar khyed nyi ma/ med/yod/5 slob dpon rin po cher rnam thar dang mthun par bstod pa/ med/med/6 rje sa chen gyi rnam thar bsdus pa/ med/yod/7 bla ma lnga bcu'i 'grel pa/ yod/med/8 byin rlabs tshar gsum khug pa bzhugs so/ /yod/med/9 lam 'bras kyi gzhung ji ltar ba bzhin du bkri ba'i khrid yig tshigs su bcad pa/ med/med/10 brtag gnyis 'grel padag ldan zhes bya ba/ yod/yod/11rgyud sde'i dum bu zhes pa/ med/med/12 bla ma brgyud pa rgya bod kyi lo rgyus/ med/ med/ sde dge'i dpar ma/ (jazha lu/lu phu/dmigs bsal gnas tshul/13 rdo rje gur gyi rgyan zhes bya ba'i rnam 'grel/ med/yod/14 rdo rje gur gyi bsdus don/ yod/yod/15 gur gyi thig chog yod/yod/16 kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa 'bring po yan lag drug pa/ yod/yod/'di mi 'dra ba shin tu mang po yod/ 17 kye rdo rje dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon par rtogs pa/ yod/med/18 bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i mngon rtogs/ yod/yod/19 byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa'i lag len gyi tho yig /yod/med/20 tshogs 'khor 'bring po/ yod/yod/21 kye rdor zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhib tu bstan pa/ yod/yod/22 kye rdo rje'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mdor bsdus/ yod/yod/23 rtsa ltung 'khrul spong*/ yod/yod/24 he ru ka'i chas drug gi bshad pa/
